description: Search the Atlas of the Middle (173 studies on middle managers and change, each with a strength grade and Unfrozen's plain-language summary). Matches words in the title, summary, setting, authors and journal. Returns each study's label, year, journal, design, grade, Loop parts, one-line summary and its unfreeze.us page. Filter by Loop part or grade.

grade.description: Only studies with this evidence-strength grade. No study is currently rated high.

limit.description: How many studies to return (1 to 20, default 8).

part.description: Only studies that inform this part of the Unfrozen Loop: P1 Surface both ways; P2 Make sense together, top included; P3 Start it close to the work; P4 Review on a rhythm, then hold the pace; P6 The middle's own weather (candidate part).

query.description: Keywords or a short question, for example "bad news upward", "Nokia", "Huy 2011" or "sensemaking during restructuring".

name: search_studies
title: Search Atlas studies
